layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one big mountain massif for a strategy map, a broad range of two or three joined summits, drawn as a standing object seen from the front with the camera only slightly above it, like a tree or a building on the same map: we see its front face, ridgelines and gullies rising up and its summits against the empty background, never its top from above. Calm and less saturated than units, a thin dark outline along the summits and upper ridges only, soft inner lines, big simple flat facets with one shadow tone. Its lower slopes spread wide and low and flatten out at the bottom edge of the image. It stands alone on the empty transparent background: nothing under it, no ground patch, no shadow.

Subject: one broad green grassy mountain massif, each image a different one of these: two rounded summits joined by a long ridge, a wide massif with three soft summits and grassy spurs, a high green mountain with a grey rocky crown and long ridges running down. Its slopes are the meadow grass of the plain around it: grass #8bb95e, lit #a6cf6e on the left faces, shadow #5e8f45 and deep gullies #44703c on the right faces; a little bare rock #9a978a, shadow #66645c near the summits. Fills the full image width and nearly its full height.
